title: PayloadAcceptanceCalendar
description: Document an installation loads under its configuration key payload.acceptance-calendar: per specification family, the release order (oldest first) and the acceptance window of each release (acceptedFrom and acceptedTo inclusive; absent acceptedTo means open-ended). Read by svc-payload and mapped to AcceptanceCalendar.of(order, entries) of integration-canon. This schema publishes the shape only; no calendar row is part of the contract. Rules this schema cannot express stay with the loader of svc-payload, which gets them from AcceptanceCalendar.of: (1) every version of an entry occurs in releaseOrder; (2) acceptedTo is not before acceptedFrom. Additive-only within a major version (API-41). The schema stays open to unknown members (API-41 tolerant reader); the loader of svc-payload refuses unknown members (fail closed).

releaseOrder.description: Release codes of the family, oldest first.

version.description: Release code; must occur in releaseOrder (checked by the loader).

acceptedTo.description: Last accepted date, inclusive; absent means open-ended.
